hooks.command: cat | jq -r '"display notification \"" + .message + "\" with title \"" + .title + "\" sound name \"Glass\""' | xargs -I {} osascript -e '{}'
osascript -e 'display notification "作業が完了しました。" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Glass"'

statusLine.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then diff_stats=$(git diff --numstat 2>/dev/null | awk '{added+=$1; deleted+=$2} END {if(added+deleted>0) printf " (+%d/-%d)", added, deleted}'); echo "on: $branch$diff_stats"; fi
